verdict.rationale: Cal.com's Bookings API explicitly supports recurring bookings (`POST /v2/bookings` creates 'regular bookings, recurring bookings and instant bookings'), and the platform has a broader 'workflows' feature (automation on booking triggers) that AI agents can drive via the API/MCP server. However, the AI-agent docs (agents.md) emphasize checking availability and creating bookings, without detailed guidance on how an AI-native user would specifically configure or manage recurring schedules end-to-end via natural language/MCP. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-facing documentation/example of creating or managing recurring bookings via MCP or agents.md, and independent/hands-on confirmation that recurring booking creation works reliably through the AI-agent flow.
